title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يشارك في مؤتمر بالجزائر
title_en: The Sheikh Takes Part in a Congress in Algeria
body_ar:
شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو –حفظه الله- اليوم السبت 22/07/2017 في المؤتمر الإستثنائي المرسم للوحدة بين حركة مجتمع السلم وجبهة التغيير تحت اسم "حركة مجتمع السلم،" بدولة الجزائر الشقيقية.

وكانت بداية الاتصال وجود وساطة من طرف فضيلة الشيخ من أجل اندماج الحركتين.

وقد ركز فضيلة الشيخ في كلمته بالمناسبة بهذا الاندماج ووجه التهنئة بداية للمسجد الأقصى الحزين هذه الأيام ولكل الخيرين وللوطن الجزائري ولكل الأمة الإسلامية

وأشاد بدور القيادة في الحركتين على التجاوب مع مساعي الصلح ونبذ الخلاف

وختم بأهمية الوحدة والتغلب على نزوات الشياطين.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew (may God preserve him) took part this Saturday, 22/07/2017, in the extraordinary congress formalising the union between the Movement of Society for Peace and the Front for Change under the name 'Movement of Society for Peace', in the fraternal state of Algeria.

The beginning of the contact was a mediation undertaken by the Sheikh for the merger of the two movements.

In his address on the occasion the Sheikh dwelt on this merger, and directed his congratulations first to the Aqsa Mosque, sorrowful in these days, and to all good people, to the Algerian homeland and to the whole Islamic community.

He praised the part played by the leadership of the two movements in responding to the efforts at reconciliation and in setting aside discord.

He closed with the importance of unity and of overcoming the promptings of the devils.

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed: the sentence is broken — ركّز takes على, not بـ, and no object follows to complete it. Either a verb has dropped out or 'ركز ... بـ' stands for something like 'رحّب بـ' ('welcomed'). The rendering chosen is the most conservative reading; it should not be settled without the site's confirmation.

flags.note: The source gives no explanation of why the Aqsa Mosque is 'sorrowful in these days'; the translation supplies none, in keeping with the rule against adding a contemporary application the Sheikh did not give. A reader in English will not follow the reference without editorial context, which is a display decision.

flags.note: EDITORIALLY SENSITIVE: the record places the Sheikh as mediator in the merger of two named political parties in a foreign state. The names are given in their usual English forms. The record reports a political role, not a legal ruling, and the display should not blur the two.

translator_notes: SOURCE DEFECT preserved: 'الجزائر الشقيقية' stands for 'الجزائر الشقيقة'; the comma inside the closing quotation mark of the party's name is also in the source.
'نزوات الشياطين' rendered 'the promptings of the devils'; نزوة is a sudden impulse.
